messages:
Harper Lane: Heads up 1: planning note: webinar will have a secondary APAC-tailored stream. Need staggered timing and a lightweight slide pack for low-bandwidth viewers.
Diego Ortiz: Good call. Proposed: primary live at 10:00 PT, APAC replay + live Q at 02:00 UTC. We should prep two slide sets: full and compact (no gifs, <3MB).
Mina Rao: I'll make the compact deck. Also request: can we get a static-image fallback for the demo if WebRTC fails?
Elliot Green: Ops will host static fallback on a CDN and swagger link to the demo prompts. Also recommend taking a VM snapshot of the demo environment 30m before show.
Nina Park: Legal: recording consent language finalized? We need a line in the registration that says "By registering you consent to recording. Content may be used for marketing." Confirmed?
Harper Lane: Yes legal sign-off received this morning. Add the text and include opt-out for follow-up emails.
Diego Ortiz: Routing: post-webinar leads from APAC stream get a custom nurture with local timezone invites. Also we'll score leads by demo interaction (clicked demo link / submitted prompt).
Mina Rao: For rehearsals: one full run in presenter view, one in compact deck view. Can we do presenter run 08:45 PT and compact view 09:15 PT?
Elliot Green: Scheduling done. OpsBot, create alert for demo endpoint errors>5 in 1m during show and page @eng-oncall.
OpsBot: Alert rule created: channel=#temp-alerts rule=demo_errors>5/1m notify=@eng-oncall
Nina Park: Post-event assets: short regional cut (1m), full recording, compact deck, and FAQ extracted from chat. Assign owners in doc.
Harper Lane: I'll own the regional cuts. Diego you'll own lead routing. Mina compacts deck. Elliot you'll handle the VM snapshot + CDN fallback.
Diego Ortiz: Confirmed. I'll also add an automation: leads with demo click -> tech-sales sequence, score +20.
Mina Rao: Ill start the compact deck now and share a first pass by 4pm PT.
Harper Lane: Great. Final cue sheet due 6pm PT, please include APAC handoff notes and fallback manual trigger steps.
